title: Salary rank within each department
prompt:
SQLite. Submit exactly one statement - a single SELECT, optionally preceded by a WITH clause (a second, semicolon-separated statement is rejected).

Table:
  employees(id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, name TEXT NOT NULL, dept TEXT NOT NULL, salary INTEGER NOT NULL)

Return one row per employee with the rank of their salary inside their own department:
the highest salary in a department ranks 1, and employees paid the same share a rank
with no gap left behind them - the next distinct salary down is 2, never 3. Columns,
named exactly: name, dept, rnk. Row order does not matter.

Example - for the rows
  ('zoe', 'qa', 90), ('kai', 'qa', 90), ('lin', 'qa', 70)
the result is  zoe|qa|1, kai|qa|1, lin|qa|2.
starterCode: -- one SELECT; columns: name, dept, rnk
